name: Koe
tagline: A twelve-month thinking coach that makes you fill in the plan yourself
description: Lays out a full year of strategic thinking as a daily habit, drawn from the Art of Strategic Thinking framework by writer Dan Koe. Every day it opens a dashboard of blank prompts and structured steps, then holds the line: you supply the answers, and it will not write them for you.
author: dannybuck
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
